text:
The two immediate-successor chains are blocks: Cara–Hana, and Ivo–Finn–Gus. Cara before Ivo puts Cara–Hana entirely earlier. Dev is before Cara and at least three slots from Ivo, and Ann is exactly two slots from Cara.

Cara in 1 is impossible (Dev has nowhere earlier). Cara in 2 forces Dev in 1 and Ann in 4; the only Ivo–Finn–Gus block that still seats Ben and Elif is 6–7–8, with Ben in 5 and Elif in 9. Cara in 3, 4, or 5 leaves no slot for Ben and Elif that keeps both the separation rules and Ann before Ben and Elif. In particular, Cara in 4 with Ivo in 7 puts Ben in 1 and Ann in 6, so Ann is not before Ben; Cara in 4 with Ivo in 6 puts Ben next to Gus.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Dev","2":"Cara","3":"Hana","4":"Ann","5":"Ben","6":"Ivo","7":"Finn","8":"Gus","9":"Elif"}
CONFIDENCE: 95
